facts.event: Elise 穿过王宫的密道，从 Cynefel 的起居室悄悄回自己房间以避开人群
facts.relation: Elise 与王族/继母 Cynefel 的宫廷关系
facts.anchor: when she used the passages for the simple task of avoiding people as she navigated

facts.event: Elise 路过教室，看见幼弟 Hein 在矮桌上练字，低阶祭司夸他字迹干净
facts.relation: Elise 与弟弟 Hein 的姐弟关系，及她被剥夺读书识字之权
facts.anchor: ‘Oh good work,’ said the low priest who was tutoring Hein.

facts.event: Elise 在密道里听见 Conrin 与 Gaisa 密谋，说父亲“正在失去掌控”，并称“羽翼在我们这边”
facts.relation: Conrin、Gaisa 与父亲（国王）之间的权力对立
facts.anchor: ‘The Wing is on our side, Gaisa. Let’s show him we are worthy of our blood.’

facts.event: Conrin 察觉墙后有人，手按剑柄低声威胁能刺穿木墙
facts.relation: Conrin 对 Elise 的敌意与武力压制
facts.anchor: ‘Trust that I can stab through a wooden wall faster than you can blink.’

facts.event: Elise 主动现身自称“Brother-hyem”，Gaisa 把手中纸条攥进掌心
facts.relation: Elise 与两位兄长的紧张关系；Egil 与“鸟”的未明计划
facts.anchor: He had what looked like a note in his hand, which he balled up in his palm

facts.event: Conrin 抓住 Elise 手腕把她按在走廊墙上逼问听见了什么，她答“什么也没看见”
facts.relation: 兄妹关系：Conrin 从手足变为施暴者，Elise 学会隐忍
facts.numbers: 她九岁、他八岁时反抗曾奏效
facts.anchor: It had worked when she was nine and he eight.
